Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body:
Take good care

Move any equipment from this action vampire to any minion as  action. If you control the target minion this is a +1 Stealth action.

This not counts as an equip action.

(The last paragraph it to disable the untap stuff and other effects)

Pachyderm Skin
pay one blood to prevent one damage
prevent one damage
play before range to prevent one damage each round of this combat.

Torch
+1 Stealth
Burn a card controlled by your prey or predator, or pay one blood to burn a card on a minion.

Sabbat Party
Called by any Archbishop, Cardinal or Regent as a +1 Stealth Action

If this referendum is successful put this card in play.Each Methuselah must pay 2 pool during the untap phase to be able to use transfers during the influence phase.

This card may be burned as +1 stealth political action called by any vampire. Titled Camarilla vampires must burn one blood to vote in this referendum.

This is a sort of Leandro/1st tradition in political for the sabbat...

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Make aone topic per card - or at the very least, per thematic, and put descriptives titbles.

As the card themselves, Tthe first is useless, the two are off-thematic and kind of broken (especially the second one, oh a +1 stealth action to burn an inner circle !), the third one is just not original and kind of useless.

Messages.Author: Louhi
Messages.Body:
Hello!

I'm just going to focus on two of them: Take Good Care and Torch. The first is redundant since the existing card Rave does the exact same thing and a little more. Also unless it's specified that it's an equip action it's a regular one I believe, no need to specify it's not an equip action.

Torch seems way too good. As Ohlmann said with the current wording it would allow you to burn a minion and even without that (I assume that's not the intent) it works like a conceal/rampage/loss but can also suddenly target previously untargettable cards like Palla Grande and Dreams of the Sphinx.

Lidingö Scourge

Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body:
Yes.. the wording on the Torch should be fixed to everything but minions...

Probably it should be disciple based and have some cost associated. The intention is just that, burn the palla grande, the week of nightmares, the vessel, etc,etc.

Rave is limited to vampires... that's the difference.

Well the intention wasn't that. I was thinking in something like smear campaign with more punch, but it might used to force the archetypes to pack some sort of defense. It probably will need a lot more thinking and and some other effects or cards to make it more balanced.

Maybe something like "The card will be out of play until your next untap phase" will make more balanced instead of just burning it...
